title: c6-clv-archive
universal_lens: The CLV operator is a functional mapping from the space of historical opening measures to closing measures. It quantifies market drift as an information-theoretic divergence, constrained by strict topological boundaries of commercial licensing and unobstructed data accessibility.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats the missing opening line as a latent variable in a hierarchical Bayesian model. Conformal inference bounds the predictive distribution of entry prices using closing lines and final scores, strictly enforcing commercial derivative constraints on posterior outputs.
gse_mapping: GSE models the betting market as a continuous-time state-transition system. The absence of the initial state (opening line) collapses the transition matrix, rendering situational edge calculations impossible unless valid historical snapshots are injected into the engine.

primitives.name: Closing-Line Value Drift Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Without it, an entry line equals the close by construction and CLV is unmeasurable.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: L_open: Opening line (dimensionless odds), L_close: Closing line (dimensionless odds), Delta_L: Market drift (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: Markets exhibit non-zero stochastic drift between opening and closing states; entry occurs at or near L_open.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Degenerates when L_open is undefined or artificially set equal to L_close, resulting in zero-measure drift and uncomputable alpha.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to GSI's alpha-generation kernel, representing the realized information advantage gained by entering prior to market consensus closure.
layer2.telemetry: Historical correlation between entry price differentials and realized game outcomes.

reasoning_traces.think:
The fundamental objective is constructing a robust Closing-Line Value (CLV) metric, which mathematically relies on the differential between an agent's entry price and the eventual market consensus. The provided excerpts establish a severe data singularity: while closing lines and final scores are abundantly available under permissive licenses (e.g., nflverse games.csv), the historical opening lines—the necessary initial conditions for the CLV operator—are entirely absent. Without these opening states, the entry line defaults to the closing line by construction, collapsing the drift variance to zero and rendering the value proposition unmeasurable. 

To resolve this, the search for an opening-line archive is bounded by three rigorous, non-negotiable constraints acting as mathematical filters. First, the Commercial Derivative Filter mandates that any sourced data must explicitly permit the commercial exploitation of derived analytical outputs, acknowledging that the raw data itself remains third-party IP. Second, the Access Topology Constraint demands completely unobstructed acquisition—no paywalls, logins, or ToS violations—ensuring the data pipeline remains deterministic and legally pristine. Third, the Granularity and Depth Requirement insists on per-game resolution spanning a minimum of three seasons to ensure statistical power. 

The derivation concludes that any proposed solution failing to satisfy these boundary conditions simultaneously is structurally worthless. The problem reduces to finding a single intersection point in the multi-dimensional space of historical US sports betting data that satisfies temporal depth, granular resolution, open topology, and commercial permissibility.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This framework inherits from the efficient-market hypothesis and the foundational work of Thorp on card counting and market arbitrage. Historically, measuring 'edge' required comparing a private probabilistic model against public market pricing. The modern evolution, championed by quantitative shops, shifted focus to Closing-Line Value as the ultimate proxy for model accuracy. The current constraint reflects the maturation of open-source sports data (like nflverse), highlighting the remaining frontier: timestamped opening liquidity.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The primary decision actor here is a sophisticated quantitative research team operating within a commercial entity (GSI/GSE). They are highly skeptical, prioritizing legal safety and computational efficiency over raw data volume. Their cognitive model assumes that most data providers will fail the commercial derivative test or hide behind restrictive ToS. They anticipate agents providing 'plausible but useless' GitHub repositories, hence the explicit warning against inferring licenses from reputation. They demand absolute verifiability.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A cross-layer veto is triggered if a dataset provides perfect opening lines but restricts commercial use; the GSI mapping immediately nullifies its utility. Similarly, if a source allows commercial use but requires complex scraping behind a login, the GSE state-transition engine vetoes it due to topological friction. The primitives are strictly anti-collinear: one measures value (CLV), one measures legal viability (Commercial Filter), and one measures engineering viability (Access Topology). All three must evaluate to TRUE for integration.
